Selling two houses from Ventnor and Marvin would cover the $600 Connecticut rent, but that would destroy the even-building balance and leave me with zero houses on two properties.

Unmortgaging orange would leave only $446, which is too little to survive a hotel hit without selling houses. I am now weighing whether to end the turn or trade for p1's mortgaged Boardwalk to complete the dark blue set.

Unmortgaging p1's mortgaged Boardwalk would cost $220, and building dark blue would require another $200 per house, so I cannot afford it. I am now considering trading my Park Place to p1 to complete their dark blue set; they have $368 in cash and could mortgage four railroads for roughly $400 more.

Handing p1 a dark-blue monopoly would create a second predator, and the trade-off is unclear unless I receive something that directly accelerates yellow to three houses.
